Drafted the six assigned carriers, both empty-body A/B pages, the batch manifest, and the source, coverage, dependency, proof-contract, and notes evidence. The source status review uses the [published Hom–Park article](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s00209-026-04050-3) and its [full-text arXiv version](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.20455).

**Checks:** proof layout passed for all six items (12 steps, 0 defects); strict proof contracts passed 6/6; source coverage passed with 20 results; all eight full-text sources are stamped. Focused dependency and statement checks also passed.

**Escalations:** the worked example’s Fox-coloring proof establishes nontriviality and sliceness, but its ribbon claim needs a proof converting a radial no-maximum disk into the A-page ribbon immersion. The required batch-74 page is absent, and its concordance-group theorem still has an unresolved topological branch. The batch-level checker also reports the existing cycle `67 → 75 → 67`; batch 81 additionally has direct suppliers in batches 60, 63, and 103.

All six Step-1 records are escalated. Two batch-74 transitive supplier proofs changed after those records were written; I reread them and preserved the escalations without overwriting them. **Their stored hashes are now stale**, so the owner must refresh them after reconciling the updated inputs. No item is marked ready or accepted.
